title: Jaron Lanier – Who is Civilization for? (+ Q&A with Ulrich Kelber) Willy Brandt Lecture 2018
summary: Jaron Lanier delivers the 2018 Willy Brandt Lecture in Berlin on who civilization is for, covering data, AI, tech platforms and the economics of who benefits, followed by a Q&A with Germany's data protection commissioner Ulrich Kelber.
why: HN cites it for Lanier's ideas on the circle of empathy and paying people whose data and work train AI.

quote.text: The best proposal I’ve heard to deal with the societal/economic problems this sort of A.I. poses were made by Jaron Lanier
